sources.title: Repository news conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original multilingual news workflow distilled from maintained content projects

claims.statement: Date-bounded research, three-source triangulation, source-language drafting before translation, CEFR readability, structured frontmatter, locale filenames, slug collision checks, and schema validation.

notes.title: Refresh Workflow
notes.text:
1. Review corrections and evaluations involving news freshness, sourcing, translations, frontmatter, filenames, and publication checks.
2. Update the smallest owning section.
3. Re-run trigger, routing, and output evaluations.
4. Update the review date after the guidance and evaluations agree.
